parsed.rationale: All three records — `SheetDraggingKey` in `WXUI/OverlaySheet.swift`, `ThemePickerActiveKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift`, and `UITestingModeKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift` — are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists.
